Name: Hot Pam - 1oxnes and talkohlooeys' Seasonal Portraits Edit
Author: IBSammy
Description:
talkohlooeys' has given permission for people to make edits to their work, and so I did. This is my second one, Hot Pam.

Install Instructions:
[list]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11904]1oxnes and talkohlooeys' Seasonal Portraits[/url]﻿ and its requirements
[*]Unzip my folder from wherever you saved it
[*]Copy contents from this unzipped folder to \Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\
[/list]
[b]Small Note: [/b]I know she doesn't match her sprite exactly, but I still think this works just as well. It's more her hair doesn't really match. If anyone wants to edit that, feel free. I may eventually, but no promises as I am happy with it as is.
